name: GitHub Dark
tagline: GitHub's default dark mode, taken off the design tokens and pressed onto the whole desktop.
notes: The reference variant. Every other GitHub theme here is a diff against this one.

contrast_exempt.muted: ANSI 8 is GitHub's own dimmed-text value and dimmed text is supposed to recede; lifting it would mean shipping a terminal palette GitHub does not have (measures 3.57:1)
